name: create_scaffold_skill
description: Interactively collect project-type requirements and write a new scaffold skill JSON to skills/builtin/. LocalClaw asks clarifying questions then generates the full skill.

args.title: Generate scaffold skill: {{skillName}}
args.description: Create a new LocalClaw scaffold skill JSON file at skills/builtin/{{skillName}}.json. Inputs collected: Skill name, Stack, Start command, Test command, Entry file, Description. Instructions: 1. Determine required project files. 2. Write file contents as args. 3. Use template variables. 4. Write skill to skills/builtin/. 5. Verify JSON validity.
